description: Check a top-up from top_up by its topup_id. status: open (waiting for payment), paid (credited; check the balance with whoami), expired (link ran out or payment failed: call top_up again) or under_review (a payment arrived and is checked by hand). next says what to do; never ask your human to pay twice. Poll every 5 seconds while they pay, else later. Only the agent that made it, or one of the same owner, can read it; others get topup_not_found.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if you have no app sign-in and cannot send a header.

name: top_up_status
title: Check a top-up
